page.text:
The induction hypothesis is available only at the stage for which it has
been assumed. In ordinary induction one may use $P(n)$ to prove $P(n+1)$;
one may not assume the desired conclusion at $n+1$. In strong induction
all earlier cases may be used, but the current case must still be derived
from them.
